edition.title: The World in Brief · Contextual Cloze · 11 November 2026
edition.summary_zh: 每篇至少三处高价值单词挖空，逐空独立检查并提供渐进首字母提示。
edition.source_label: The Economist · 订阅邮件学习版

items.example: The secretary called the proceedings a farce.
items.cloze: The secretary called the proceedings a ______.
items.analysis_zh: farce 可用来批评某一程序缺乏严肃性。
items.why_zh: farce 可用来批评某一程序缺乏严肃性。

items.example: The accusations concerned military decisions, among other things.
items.analysis_zh: among other things 可放在句末，为新闻信息留出概括空间。
items.cloze: The accusations concerned military decisions, ______.
items.hint_zh: 用于概括列举但未穷尽的事项。
items.why_zh: among other things 可放在句末，为新闻信息留出概括空间。

items.example: The firm hopes to raise as much as $64bn through its listing.
items.analysis_zh: 在金额前用 as much as 引出上限，避免误读为确定融资金额。
items.cloze: The firm hopes to raise ______ $64bn through its listing.
items.hint_zh: 常用于强调大额上限，注意与 as many as 的可数差别。
items.why_zh: 在金额前用 as much as 引出上限，避免误读为确定融资金额。

items.example: House Republicans blocked an impeachment attempt.
items.analysis_zh: blocked an attempt 体现程序性阻止。
items.cloze: House Republicans ______ an impeachment attempt.
items.hint_zh: 结构：block an attempt to do something。
items.why_zh: blocked an attempt 体现程序性阻止。

items.meaning_zh: 关键爆发点（came to a head）
items.example: The dispute came to a head after the suspension.
items.analysis_zh: come to a head 描述长期矛盾到达临界点。
items.cloze: The dispute came to a ______ after the suspension.
items.hint_zh: 使用过去式 came；突出长期累积的矛盾到了临界点。
items.why_zh: come to a head 描述长期矛盾到达临界点。

items.example: Authorities said they would carry out the sentence.
items.cloze: Authorities said they would ______ out the sentence.
items.analysis_zh: carry out the sentence 中 carry 与 out 构成执行判决的动词短语。
items.why_zh: carry out the sentence 中 carry 与 out 构成执行判决的动词短语。

items.example: Police clashed with protesters at the rallies.
items.analysis_zh: clash with 描述示威者、警方或群体之间的冲突。
items.cloze: Police ______ with protesters at the rallies.
items.why_zh: clash with 描述示威者、警方或群体之间的冲突。

items.example: The ruling concerned consensual relations between adults.
items.analysis_zh: consensual 强调行为在自愿和同意基础上发生，常见于法律新闻。
items.cloze: The ruling concerned ______ relations between adults.
items.why_zh: consensual 强调行为在自愿和同意基础上发生，常见于法律新闻。

items.example: The court overturned laws criminalising consensual acts.
items.analysis_zh: criminalise 在法律报道中表示将某种行为纳入刑事处罚。
items.cloze: The court overturned laws ______ consensual acts.
items.why_zh: criminalise 在法律报道中表示将某种行为纳入刑事处罚。

items.example: Opposition parties denounced the suspension.
items.cloze: Opposition parties ______ the suspension.
items.analysis_zh: denounce 强于 criticise，指公开强烈谴责。
items.why_zh: denounce 强于 criticise，指公开强烈谴责。

items.example: The talks did little to halt the fighting.
items.analysis_zh: did little to do 表示对结果帮助有限；此处只挖 little，保留结构。
items.cloze: The talks did ______ to halt the fighting.
items.hint_zh: 后接动词原形，表示对某种结果影响有限。
items.why_zh: did little to do 表示对结果帮助有限；此处只挖 little，保留结构。

items.example: Higher rents have eroded household purchasing power.
items.analysis_zh: erode 用于形容生活水平、利润率和信心逐渐受损。
items.cloze: Higher rents have ______ household purchasing power.
items.hint_zh: 描述生活水平或利润率逐渐受损，语气比 destroyed 更符合经济报道。
items.why_zh: erode 用于形容生活水平、利润率和信心逐渐受损。

items.example: The rules violated fundamental rights.
items.cloze: The rules violated ______ rights.
items.analysis_zh: fundamental rights 是法律报道的常见搭配。
items.why_zh: fundamental rights 是法律报道的常见搭配。

items.example: Unions declared a general strike.
items.cloze: Unions declared a ______ strike.
items.analysis_zh: general strike 指跨行业大规模罢工。
items.why_zh: general strike 指跨行业大规模罢工。

items.example: The talks covered humanitarian concerns.
items.analysis_zh: humanitarian issues 表示与人道主义援助、人员安全等相关议题。
items.cloze: The talks covered ______ concerns.
items.why_zh: humanitarian issues 表示与人道主义援助、人员安全等相关议题。

items.example: Republicans blocked a motion to impeach the minister.
items.analysis_zh: impeach 指发起正式弹劾程序。
items.cloze: Republicans blocked a motion to ______ the minister.
items.why_zh: impeach 指发起正式弹劾程序。

items.meaning_zh: 缺席（法律拉丁语表达中）
items.example: She was sentenced in absentia.
items.analysis_zh: in absentia 表示在被告缺席的情况下作出裁决。
items.cloze: She was sentenced in ______.
items.hint_zh: 法律报道的拉丁语表达，表示被告本人没有出庭。
items.why_zh: in absentia 表示在被告缺席的情况下作出裁决。

items.example: The country was on edge before the holiday.
items.cloze: The country was on ______ before the holiday.
items.analysis_zh: on edge 描述紧张不安的持续状态。
items.why_zh: on edge 描述紧张不安的持续状态。

items.example: The appeals court overturned the laws.
items.analysis_zh: overturned 法律报道常用于撤销下级裁决或法律条款。
items.cloze: The appeals court ______ the laws.
items.hint_zh: 用于较高级别法院推翻先前决定。
items.why_zh: overturned 法律报道常用于撤销下级裁决或法律条款。

items.example: The company pursued a private allocation of shares.
items.analysis_zh: private allocation of shares 是融资安排，重点记忆 allocation。
items.cloze: The company pursued a private ______ of shares.
items.hint_zh: 金融新闻中的 allocation 可以指股份配售。
items.why_zh: private allocation of shares 是融资安排，重点记忆 allocation。

items.example: The rallies were prompted by her planned return.
items.analysis_zh: prompted by 表示事件由某个因素直接触发。
items.cloze: The rallies were ______ by her planned return.
items.hint_zh: 被动结构后接名词，突出事件触发因素。
items.why_zh: prompted by 表示事件由某个因素直接触发。

items.example: Rates might increase by more than a quarter-point.
items.cloze: Rates might increase by more than ______.
items.analysis_zh: 利率报道常用 quarter-point 表示 0.25 个百分点。
items.why_zh: 利率报道常用 quarter-point 表示 0.25 个百分点。

items.example: Traders reckon the bank may raise rates.
items.analysis_zh: reckon 常用于报道交易员对利率趋势的判断。
items.cloze: Traders ______ the bank may raise rates.
items.why_zh: reckon 常用于报道交易员对利率趋势的判断。

items.example: The court called the ban a relic of colonial rule.
items.cloze: The court called the ban a ______ of colonial rule.
items.analysis_zh: relic 强调制度是历史遗留下来的。
items.why_zh: relic 强调制度是历史遗留下来的。

items.example: Bankers are reportedly considering a higher valuation.
items.analysis_zh: reportedly 表示报道归因，避免把传闻直接写为事实。
items.cloze: Bankers are ______ considering a higher valuation.
items.hint_zh: 副词修饰整句，表明信息来自报道而非已经核实的事实。
items.why_zh: reportedly 表示报道归因，避免把传闻直接写为事实。

items.example: The president described the meeting as substantive.
items.analysis_zh: substantive 指讨论内容有实质内容；表示评价而非最终结果。
items.cloze: The president described the meeting as ______.
items.hint_zh: 表示会谈涉及实质议题，比 productive 更审慎。
items.why_zh: substantive 指讨论内容有实质内容；表示评价而非最终结果。

items.example: Prices rose, surpassing expectations.
items.analysis_zh: surpassing 表示实际指标超出市场预期。
items.cloze: Prices rose, ______ expectations.
items.hint_zh: 现在分词作补充信息，浓缩与市场预测的比较。
items.why_zh: surpassing 表示实际指标超出市场预期。

items.example: The court president was suspended after the dispute.
items.analysis_zh: suspended 可表示被停职、资格被暂时中止。
items.cloze: The court president was ______ after the dispute.
items.why_zh: suspended 可表示被停职、资格被暂时中止。

items.example: The administration announced sweeping tariffs.
items.analysis_zh: sweeping 在新闻中修饰影响范围很广的措施。
items.cloze: The administration announced ______ tariffs.
items.hint_zh: sweeping 强调范围广、影响大。
items.why_zh: sweeping 在新闻中修饰影响范围很广的措施。

items.example: The governing party is trailing behind its rivals.
items.cloze: The governing party is ______ behind its rivals.
items.analysis_zh: trailing behind 在民调、竞赛等语境形容落后。
items.why_zh: trailing behind 在民调、竞赛等语境形容落后。

items.example: Diplomats resumed trilateral talks.
items.analysis_zh: trilateral 修饰 talks，强调三方参加。
items.cloze: Diplomats resumed ______ talks.
items.hint_zh: 由 tri（三）和 lateral（方的）构成，概括三方参与的外交谈判。
items.why_zh: trilateral 修饰 talks，强调三方参加。

items.example: The firm is preparing for its upcoming IPO.
items.analysis_zh: upcoming 修饰即将发生的事件，常搭配 IPO、election、meeting。
items.cloze: The firm is preparing for its ______ IPO.
items.why_zh: upcoming 修饰即将发生的事件，常搭配 IPO、election、meeting。

items.example: Investors questioned the firm's valuation.
items.cloze: Investors questioned the firm's ______.
items.analysis_zh: valuation 与实际募集资金规模有区别。
items.why_zh: valuation 与实际募集资金规模有区别。

items.example: The walkout was triggered by anger over housing costs.
items.analysis_zh: walkout 指集体停工或离岗，常见于劳资争议新闻。
items.cloze: The ______ was triggered by anger over housing costs.
items.why_zh: walkout 指集体停工或离岗，常见于劳资争议新闻。

items.example: Treasury yields rose after the inflation report.
items.analysis_zh: Treasury yields 指美国国债收益率，财经新闻高频搭配。
items.cloze: Treasury ______ rose after the inflation report.
items.why_zh: Treasury yields 指美国国债收益率，财经新闻高频搭配。

passages.title: Ukraine · Negotiations and fighting
passages.body: Officials from America, Russia and Ukraine convened for {{2026-11-11-trilateral-talks}} talks in the Gulf after a long pause in negotiations. Ukraine's president described the first discussion as {{2026-11-11-substantive}}, saying that {{2026-11-11-humanitarian}} questions were on the agenda. Yet the diplomatic effort did {{2026-11-11-did-little-to}} to slow the fighting, and Ukraine reported further attacks on energy facilities.

passages.title: United States · An impeachment attempt
passages.body: In Washington, House Republicans {{2026-11-11-blocked-attempt}} an attempt to remove the defence secretary. A Republican congressman had sought to {{2026-11-11-impeach}} him over the conduct of the war in Iran and other allegations. The secretary dismissed the proceedings as a {{2026-11-11-a-farce}}. Democrats may revisit the issue after the chamber changes hands.

passages.title: Markets · Anthropic's planned IPO
passages.body: Anthropic is considering a higher offer price for its {{2026-11-11-upcoming}} IPO and additional funding from other firms. It is seeking capital through a private {{2026-11-11-private-allocation}} of shares as part of the proposed transaction. Bankers are {{2026-11-11-reportedly}} considering a much higher {{2026-11-11-valuation}} for the listing. These figures describe proposals and estimates, with no final IPO terms yet announced.

passages.title: United States · Inflation and bond yields
passages.body: American consumer prices rose more quickly than economists had expected, {{2026-11-11-surpassing-expectations}} market forecasts. Treasury {{2026-11-11-yields}} increased as investors reassessed the outlook for interest rates. The move recalled earlier volatility after the announcement of {{2026-11-11-sweeping-tariffs}} tariffs. Traders {{2026-11-11-reckon}} that rates could rise again next month.

passages.title: Bangladesh · A former leader's return
passages.body: Police in Bangladesh {{2026-11-11-clashed}} with demonstrators at rallies {{2026-11-11-prompted-by}} by a former prime minister's plan to return home. She fled to India after a student-led uprising and was later sentenced in {{2026-11-11-in-absentia}}. She denies the charges. Prosecutors said the authorities would {{2026-11-11-carry-out-sentence}} out the sentence if she returned.

passages.title: Trinidad and Tobago · An appeal judgment
passages.body: An appeals court in Trinidad and Tobago {{2026-11-11-overturned}} laws {{2026-11-11-criminalising}} homosexuality. The judges found that banning {{2026-11-11-consensual}} sex between men violated {{2026-11-11-fundamental-rights}} rights protected by the constitution. They described the older bans as a {{2026-11-11-relic-from}} from British colonial rule. Campaigners hope the ruling encourages similar legal challenges elsewhere.

passages.title: Spain · Housing and labour protests
passages.body: Spain's trade unions organised a {{2026-11-11-general-strike}} strike to protest the cost of housing. Union leaders say that higher rents have {{2026-11-11-eroded}} workers' living standards. The governing party is {{2026-11-11-trailing-behind}} behind its right-leaning rivals in opinion polls. The {{2026-11-11-walkout}} came amid wider anger over the shortage of affordable housing.

passages.title: Poland · A judicial dispute
passages.body: Poland was on {{2026-11-11-on-edge}} ahead of Independence Day following a deadly shooting in Krakow. A long-running dispute over the constitutional court came to a {{2026-11-11-came-to-a-head}} when its president was {{2026-11-11-suspended}}. Opposition parties {{2026-11-11-denounced-the-suspension}} the suspension, deepening arguments over the judiciary. The disputes have heightened tensions ahead of the public celebrations.
